_about: NBL27 head coaches and the NBL seasons they were head coach in since 2015-16, the first season of the official NBL box scores (nblR). 'stints': one per season and club; 'from' = the date he took over mid-season (games from that date on are his). 'record' and 'titles': his whole NBL head-coaching career (finals included) from Wikipedia's NBL All-Time Coaching Records, to the end of 2025-26. Each coach lists the sources read (25-26 Oct 2026). Used by coaches/build.py; update it when a club changes coach. 'career': every head-coaching job he has held, club by club and season by season in any league (oldest first); w/l = his own regular-season record where the source gives it for his games, team = the club's record when his own isn't known (part seasons, shared roles), pos/of/grp = the club's regular-season place, res = playoffs; src = the pages read (26 Oct 2026). NBL seasons from 2015-16 are checked against the official results by build.py. 'national': national-team jobs; 'side' marks an off-season job held alongside an NBL one; 'stats' = the club's name in overseas_teams.json, for a full overseas season that also goes in the drop-down.
